# What global_invest is

## One module per ecosystem service, two outputs

::: r-fit-text
- `global_invest` holds one folder per ecosystem service, each on the same file convention
- Every service produces **both**:
  - a **GEP valuation** — the value of the service, per country
  - an **NGFS shock** — the change in the service under a scenario, for GTAP
- Both come from the same five files per service, so the science is written once
:::

## The five-file convention

::: r-fit-text
- `run_<svc>.py` — standalone GEP run · `run_<svc>_shock.py` — standalone shock run
- `<svc>_tasks.py` — ProjectFlow tasks · `<svc>_functions.py` — the science functions
- `<svc>_initialize.py` — the task-tree builders + `add_<svc>_tasks(p, parent=None)` shock seam
- `<svc>_method.qmd` — the method write-up
:::

# The services

## Five services

::: r-fit-text
- **terrestrial_carbon** — carbon stock × price
- **pollination** — crop value attributable to pollinators
- **erosion** — sediment retention / avoided on-farm and downstream damage
- **fisheries** — CWoN-based fisheries shock (valuation external)
- **coastal_carbon** — coastal (blue-carbon) stock × price
:::
